values: Zero Filling and Persistent Free Subgroups of the Figure-Eight Knot (v1.0): negative answer to the literal universal OWR2020 question; zero torus-bundle filling kills a nontrivial word in every rank-two free subgroup, while all rational filling groups are infinite. Classical ingredients credited; positive hyperbolic-example question unresolved. Priority explicitly incomplete, no historical-first claim. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; no human peer review. PR #582; new sequential full-package review loop passed after citation correction.

A Minimal-Surface Counterexample to a Seshadri Lower Bound, v1.0, Alec Kriebel. Complete counterexample to the primary Szemberg2007/2008 / OWR2009Conj2 bound: every integer d>=7, ample K, K^2=6(d-1)(d-3), ample integral L^2=6, epsilon<=1/(d-1); d7 gives K^2=144 and epsilon<=1/6. Classical Miranda/pencil/cover methods credited. Historical priority cannot be fully cleared; no firstness or continued-open guarantee. Upper bound at special points on varying surfaces; fixed-surface question unresolved. Paper and authored verification package; nine offline jobs reproduced. Two fresh full-package adversarial reviews, final zero actionable issues after producer fixes. AI used extensively; internal AI reviews; unrefereed, no human peer review or formal certification. Accepted PR585.

A relation-incidence proof of Tohăneanu's low-exponent supersolvability conjecture. Full characteristic-zero result, including all ranks, products and nonessential arrangements; five-page note and exact verification package. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, no independent human peer review. Credits earlier methods and Ferudun's matching October 12 preprint; no exhaustive first-priority claim. PR #618: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/618

Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample. Skeide's first module-approach problem, OWR 2009 pp. 542–543; catalogue ID 30001184 / OWR-3392-012. Accepted negative counterexample to generation-only universal GNS descent for general unital C*-E0 dilations. Explicit corollary of Burgarth-Facchi-Hillier's established clock/evaluation/translated-unitary mechanism; conditional extension after kernel invariance, stronger minimality and normal W*-promotion remain unresolved here. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, no independent human peer review or exhaustive first-priority claim. PR #623: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/623
